review_reference: Backend release backend-40075271012-1-dffad84fe4a163fa (D-Eminence/hid-system#109 at 0d32961, deployed 2026-10-24 08:31 UTC with status success for all 12 services, migration 0084_patient_emergency_contacts applied first), which every pinned service runs. notification-api is pinned too, because the emergency-contact verification code and alert texts are its. Browser-facing changes since identity-api 6f8800f: GET /api/v1/identity/me/emergency-contacts/availability ({delivery, channels}); the six patient emergency-contact routes (list, add, update, deactivate, verification, confirm), which answer 409 EMERGENCY_CONTACT_DELIVERY_UNAVAILABLE for add and send while delivery is off; POST /api/v1/admin/facilities/:facilityId/alert-phone (platform.facility.manage) and alertPhoneE164 on the admin facility read; POST /api/v1/admin/emergency-contacts/opt-out (platform.emergency-contact.manage); and the inbox code EMERGENCY_CONTACT_OPTED_OUT. This frontend reads availability first and shows the Settings card only when delivery is on or contacts exist, and on novu-v1 adds the facility alert phone and the support opt-out page to the admin console. Reviewed and approved by the repository owner, D-Eminence.
